# Josephine Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** presumed seventy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Josephine Barry is an elderly woman who appears thin, prim, and rigid. She has a wrinkled cheek and sharp black eyes that remain bright and undimmed despite her growing age.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)_

## Personality

Josephine Barry is a prim, proper, and critical older woman known for her sharp tongue and selfish nature, having rarely cared for anyone other than herself. Despite these traits, she is exceptionally hospitable when entertaining guests and shows a distinct favor toward [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P26](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)_

## History

Josephine Barry, an elderly relative who lived in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), was initially enraged when [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally jumped on her in a spare-room bed while staying at [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) Barry's house. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visited her to confess and apologize, Josephine was charmed by the girl's candidness, forgiving [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and extending her stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She developed a strong friendship with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), later inviting her and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to stay at her town home, [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), to visit the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). Josephine continued to offer her hospitality and affection, regularly receiving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for visits during her time studying at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) and attending her celebratory commencement.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. ## Quotes

> "I dare say your claim to sympathy is just as strong as mine. It all depends on the way we look at it. Sit down here and tell me about yourself."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088)

> "Mercy, child, how you have grown! You’re taller than I am, I declare. And you’re ever so much better-looking than you used to be, too. But I dare say you know that without being told."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018)

> "Remember, you Anne-girl, when you come to town you’re to visit me and I’ll put you in my very sparest spare-room bed to sleep."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P96](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0096)

> "Oh, I must, hey? I rather think Diana did her share of the jumping at least. Such carryings on in a respectable house!"
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P82](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0082)

> "I don’t think you are a fit little girl for Diana to associate with. You’d better go home and behave yourself."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P64](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0064)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine Barry and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) first met under disastrous circumstances when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally jumped onto her in a dark guest bed, furious at the disruption. However, when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) went to her to apologize directly, Josephine was charmed by the girl's candid manner and imagination, prompting her to forgive the children and become close friends with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their bond grew to the point where Josephine hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) home for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and expressed great pride in Anne's academic achievements at commencement.

- Friend of — expressed pride in her achievements at commencement  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P16](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0016)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine Barry is Diana's formidable grand-aunt, who initially threatened to leave [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) and cancel Diana's music lessons after [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally jumped on her in the spare-room bed. After forgiving the mistake, she maintains a generous relationship with her grand-niece. She later hosts [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her town home, [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), giving them an exciting trip to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition).

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011)</sub>
